name: Question 13
problem:
Consider the curve defined parametrically as 

$$
x=3{t}^{2},\,y=2{t}^{3},\,t\in [0,\sqrt{3}].
$$

Calculate the surface area generated when this curve is rotated $2\pi $ radians about the $y$-axis.
